page_title: FRE 1-1 HEI | Freiburg v Heidenheim 11/05/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+6' Heidenheim are awarded a free kick from long range.
90+3' Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) sends the resulting free kick a whisker wide of the left post! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Heidenheim.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
89' Christian Streich prepares a substitution. Roland Sallai is replaced by Maximilian Philipp (Freiburg).
89' Substitution. Jan-Niklas Beste did his best and is replaced by Adrian Beck (Heidenheim).
87' The corner is swung in but Heidenheim can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
87' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Jan-Niklas Beste (Heidenheim). Corner kick. Heidenheim will have an opportunity.
85' Omar Haktab Traore (Heidenheim) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Daniel Siebert blows his whistle for a foul.

83' Yannik Keitel (Freiburg) produces an effort from the edge of the box, but doesn't hit the ball properly and sends it yards wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Heidenheim will have a goal kick.
82' Florian Pick (Heidenheim) is penalised for holding. Daniel Siebert signals a set piece. A free kick has been awarded to Freiburg.
81' Freiburg seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
78' A substitution has been made. Christian Gunter goes off and Noah Weisshaupt (Freiburg) comes on.
77' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Michael Gregoritsch as he is replaced by Lucas Holer (Freiburg).
77' The attendance is 34000.
74' Frank Schmidt has decided to substitute Marvin Pieringer and he is replaced by Denis Thomalla (Heidenheim).
74' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Florian Pick (Heidenheim) comes onto the pitch so that Kevin Sessa can be given a rest.
73' Roland Sallai (Freiburg) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.

72' The ball spins to Roland Sallai (Freiburg) on the edge of the box. He hits across the ball and sends it goalwards, but it goes just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Heidenheim will have a goal kick.
69' Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) weaves through the defence and gets one-on-one with the keeper, but fails to score.
65' Frank Schmidt has decided to make a change. Nikola Dovedan (Heidenheim) replaces Eren Dinkci.
65' Substitution. Jonas Fohrenbach is replaced by Lennard Maloney (Heidenheim).

65' Close! Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) unleashes a rocket of a shot from the edge of the box and his shot flies just a few inches over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Heidenheim.
64' Yellow card! It's like Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) was asking for a caution with his behaviour. Daniel Siebert agrees and books him.
62' Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) is found in space by a decent pass, and he immediately hits a rocket of a shot at goal that clips the top of the crossbar.
57' Christian Streich has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Jordy Makengo (Freiburg) replacing Manuel Gulde.

55' Michael Gregoritsch (Freiburg) gets to a rebound in front of goal and sends the ball towards the middle of the goal. However, he couldn't beat Kevin Muller, who shows off his superb goalkeeping ability by pulling off a great save.

55' Manuel Gulde (Freiburg) wastes a great chance as he climbs high around the penalty spot to connect with a cross from the resulting free kick. He plants a header against the right post and it bounces away off it.
54' Christian Gunter (Freiburg) is going to send the ball in from the free kick.
53' Freiburg failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
52' Michael Gregoritsch (Freiburg) spanks one well wide of the left post from the edge of the box. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Heidenheim.
51' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Heidenheim comes to nothing.
49' Surely that's handball by one of the Heidenheim players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
49' Freiburg will look to benefit from a promising free kick near the touchline.
48' Christian Gunter (Freiburg) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+3' The end of the first half.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
43' Heidenheim take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
41' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Eren Dinkci (Heidenheim), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.

38' 1 - 1 An amazing individual effort from Kevin Sessa (Heidenheim) ends with a strike from inside the penalty area. He sends the ball precisely into the bottom left corner and makes it 1:1. Noah Atubolu was helpless.

36' What an opportunity! Jan Schoppner (Heidenheim) leaps high to meet a beautiful cross into the box from the free kick, and he plants a header from near the penalty spot which goes a whisker over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Freiburg.

35' Yannik Keitel (Freiburg) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Daniel Siebert no option but to blow his whistle. Heidenheim will take a free kick near the side line.
35' The ratio of the ball possession is 45:55.
29' 1 - 0 Ritsu Doan (Freiburg) scores from quite a difficult position as he leaps high to connect with a cross and powers his header low inside the right post. Excellent finish.
24' It's a nice effort by Michael Gregoritsch (Freiburg) from the edge of the box, but it's low towards the middle of the goal and straight down the throat of Kevin Muller. Easy save.
22' Michael Gregoritsch (Freiburg) latches on to a pin-point through ball, but one of the defending players dispossess him. Brilliant defending.
18' Daniel Siebert shows the yellow card to Kevin Sessa (Heidenheim) for a heavy challenge.

16' What a chance that is! Michael Gregoritsch (Freiburg) finds himself unmarked in a promising position after receiving a cross on the edge of the box and his attempt sails a whisker wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Heidenheim.

13' Yannik Keitel (Freiburg) creates himself some space around the penalty spot and connects with the free kick. His header is so wild it sails way past the right post and behind for a goal kick. The ball goes out of play and Heidenheim will have a goal kick.
9' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Freiburg.
9' Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) unleashes a bullet of a shot that is blocked by a defender. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Freiburg.
8' Jan-Niklas Beste (Heidenheim) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.

7' Jonas Fohrenbach (Heidenheim) picks up the rebound from his own attempted pass and decides to shoot from mid-range. He shouldn't have bothered as the ball flies miles over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Freiburg.
6' Jan-Niklas Beste (Heidenheim) will take a corner kick.
4' Lukas Kubler (Freiburg) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
1' The first half has just begun.
Freiburg will kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Daniel Siebert.
